_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persons" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "relation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "phone" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_self" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_self" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "funds" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "description" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_accounts" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_type" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_bn" TEXT NULL, "institution" TEXT NULL, "number_hint" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obligations" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "fund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES funds (id), "title" TEXT NULL, "opened_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_on" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "samities" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "fund_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES funds (id), "contribution_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "start_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "samity_members" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "samity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES samities (id), "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), "shares" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "joined_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("samity_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_accounts (id), "limit_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("month_key", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NULL CHECK("amount" IS NULL OR "amount" > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BDT', "fee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "increase" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("increase" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "reference_no" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL, "fund_id" TEXT NULL, "to_fund_id" TEXT NULL, "from_account_id" TEXT NULL, "to_account_id" TEXT NULL, "obligation_id" TEXT NULL, "samity_id" TEXT NULL, "recon_session_id" TEXT NULL, "reverses_tx_id" TEXT NULL, "reversed_by_tx_id" TEXT NULL, "replaces_tx_id" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "posted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "device_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_lines" ("tx_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_transactions (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_accounts (id), "fund_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES funds (id), "person_id" TEXT NULL, "counter_fund_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" IS NOT 0), PRIMARY KEY ("tx_id", "line_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tx_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_transactions (id), "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recon_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_accounts (id), "fund_id" TEXT NULL, "as_of_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actual_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "adjustment_tx_id" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL, "approved_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "key_values" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX tx_status_date ON ledger_transactions (status, date_key, sort_key)
CREATE INDEX tx_person ON ledger_transactions (person_id)
CREATE INDEX tx_obligation ON ledger_transactions (obligation_id)
CREATE INDEX tx_samity ON ledger_transactions (samity_id)
CREATE INDEX tx_sync ON ledger_transactions (sync_status)
CREATE INDEX line_account ON transaction_lines (account_id, fund_id)
CREATE INDEX line_fund ON transaction_lines (fund_id)
CREATE INDEX line_person ON transaction_lines (person_id, account_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_entity ON audit_events (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_state ON outbox (state, next_attempt_at)
